description: This file defines a Python module implementing a search transformation interface for SearXNG's search API. It includes classes and methods to configure HTTP requests, transform search queries and responses, and manage request parameters specific to SearXNG. The code integrates with a larger framework for search providers, providing standardized request and response formats.

classes.name: SearXNGSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for SearXNG search API, providing methods to validate environment, construct URLs, transform search requests, and parse responses.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns the user-friendly name of the search provider, 'SearXNG'.

methods.name: get_http_method(self)
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for requests, which is 'GET' for SearXNG.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and prepares request headers, including optional API key authentication.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for the search request, including query parameters.

methods.name: Dict transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms a generic search query and parameters into SearXNG-specific request format.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into a standardized SearchResponse object.
